title: Composite-gravity black hole PRL verification package
description:
Symbolic checks and figure assets for the Physical Review Letters submission on the static composite-gravity black hole (draft title in the scripts: “Gauge-regular but metric-singular”). This repository is the data and code availability package for that submission. It ships the verification programs as provided and the merged invariant figure. It does not re-derive the theory.

Conventions stated in the scripts follow Öttinger, J. Phys. Commun. 10, 105003 (2026): tetrad (45), metric (46), solution (51), composition rule (4), field strength (18), and field equations (19). Units in both scripts are r0 = 1 (geometrized, r0 = Gm/c2).

The scripts check (49) versus (19), the Lie-algebra invariant F·F, and curvature-related metric invariants (PPN β = γ = 1, the photon sphere, and Killing surface gravity). This package includes verify_49_solves_19.py, the dedicated (49)-versus-(19) residual check.
